item.title: Full professor: Selection procedure by call for Full professors (professori di I fascia). 2026_PRO_DCMC_1 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-19 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milano
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/ICHI-01 Sistemi, metodi e tecnologie dell'ingegneria chimica e di processo

The successful candidate will be responsible for teaching courses covering topics in Chemical Engineering, Food Engineering, and Industrial Process Safety. Teaching duties will focus on transport phenomena, chemical reaction engineering, and systems with large interfacial areas. The candidates research activities will focus on the development of polymeric nanoparticles for biomedical applications, the reactivity of polymer systems, and the fluid dynamics of multiphase systems, with particular emphasis on interdisciplinary aspects. item.title: Full professor: Selection procedure by call for Full professors (professori di I fascia). 2026_PRO_DMEC_1 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-12 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milano
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IIND-03 Progettazione industriale, costruzioni meccaniche e metallurgia

In line with the activities of the Methods and Tools for Product Design section, the Department of Mechanical Engineering of Politecnico di Milano seeks a full professor. The scientific commitment will concern the development of methodologies for the modelling, generation and optimisation of complex geometries, aimed at exploiting the potential of additive technologies while integrating criteria of environmental sustainability and life cycle assessment. The successful candidate will be expected to promote and coordinate national and international research projects, contributing to the scientific positioning of the Department.
